title: Balanced section tensor realization of the normalized internal scalar tensorator
statement: For every morphism a of commutative condensed rings and scheme T, fix ScalarSectionData c satisfying ScalarSectionNormalized, and TensorIso b satisfying TensorNormalized. There exists a section derived tensor isomorphism barB satisfying both TensorSectionCondition and SectionTensorNormalized of [def-sfb-quotient-section-tensor-data]. Thus its ordinary transformation sends s tensor (m tensor n) to (1 tensor m) tensor (s tensor n), its signed total is specified on every coproduct summand and by the scalar model counit, and its conjugation is the given b.

source.place: Tags 06YS, 06YY, 0G7E, 07A4, 07A6; sites-modules.tex Tags 03EK and 03EL. Extracted from lem-sfb-quotient-section-tensor-normalization.

proof.text: Construct the normalized section tensor comparison and its ordinary pure-tensor and signed-total counit equations by the presheaf balancing, sheafification, K-flat totalization and resolving-class descent argument.

Conjugate the supplied internal tensorator through the fixed scalar and tensor comparisons. Its value on flat-term K-flat generators is the totalized balancing map by the normalized section computation, and exactness and essential surjectivity extend the equality to every derived pair.
Apply the two preceding independent components to the same barB and package their conclusions as the required conjunction.

theorem section_tensor_transport (T : Scheme.{u}) (c : ScalarSectionData a T)
    (hc : ScalarSectionNormalized a T c) (b : TensorIso a T)
    (hb : TensorNormalized a T b) :
    ∃ barB : tensor Λ T ⋙ c.model.T ≅ (c.model.T.prod c.model.T) ⋙ tensor Λ' T,
      TensorSectionCondition a T c b barB ∧ SectionTensorNormalized a T c barB
